Calculate BMI and print the category.

Supplied answer
weight = float(input("Weight in kg: "))
height = float(input("Height in metres: "))
bmi = weight / (height ** 2)
print(f"BMI = {bmi:.2f}")
if bmi < 18.5:
    print("Underweight")
elif bmi < 25:
    print("Normal")
elif bmi < 30:
    print("Overweight")
else:
    print("Obese")
